label: preparing
what: Innkeeper, freight and builder are jointly preparing an eighteen-o'clock town-hall gathering, with substantial bread refreshments: an original 120 loaves plus 80 extra paid for by builder. Baker supplies the bread; secretary arranges the appointment and mayor's escort. The mayor has approved a vaguely described civic-hospitality meeting but has not been given its detailed agenda or full purpose. Reports about bridge or port proposals remain unconfirmed; there is insufficient evidence to identify a more specific hidden purpose or to count neighbour as a knowing participant.
